Typedef Documentation

typedef asciichat_error_t(*) acds_protocol_send_fn(void *, packet_type_t, const void *, size_t)

Event-driven discovery protocol. Callbacks consume borrowed data before returning. The caller owns transport I/O, deadlines, and serialization of calls to this object. No function waits for input or owns the transport.
